rss: Viagogo may have broken law on hidden fees, watchdog provisionally finds
title: Tricky Pricing Tricks Found!
story: A big ticket website is in trouble for hiding extra costs. This means people paid more than they thought!
storyBig: A ticket reselling website might be using 'drip pricing,' where extra fees sneak in at the end of a purchase. This can lead to customers paying more than they initially expected.
think: Why is it important to know all costs before buying something?
bull: You might learn to spot hidden costs before buying!
bear: Watch out for tricky pricing when shopping online.

rss: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
title: New Light Chips Shine Bright!
story: Europe is trying to make new computer chips that use light. These chips could make things work super fast!
storyBig: Europe aims to lead in developing photonic chips, which use light to process data faster than traditional ones. This innovation could transform tech industries significantly.
think: How do new technologies change the way we use computers?
bull: New chips could make your gadgets work faster!
bear: Developing new technology can take a long time.
